title: Polynomial-time satisfiability for a special case of Positive$\wedge$Negative
summary: A Boolean function in CNF format is of type Positive$\wedge$Negative} if each clause C is either positive (i.e. all literals of C are positive) or negative (i.e. all literals of C are negative). As is well known, deciding the satisfiability of such CNFs is NP-complete. We say that a CNF is of type DisjointPositive if its clauses are positive and mutually disjoint. Dually define DisjointNegative. It is shown that the satisfiability of CNFs of type DisjointPositive$\wedge$DisjointNegative can be decided in quadratic time.
